itens.trecho: Mais do mesmo. Este filme está definido no fim da Idade do Gelo e é outra sequência de "Idade do Gelo". Neste filme, os animais terão um encontro improvável com os dinossauros, que se presumia estarem extintos. Dirigido por Carlos Saldanha e Mike Thurmeier, tem actores de voz como Ray Romano, John Leguizamo, Queen Latifah e Denis Leary.
When "Sid" crashes through the ice and discovers a nest of eggs, he is soon rather unwillingly adopted by their parent and finds himself in a lost, more dangerous and Jurassic, world.

Before this movie, Scrat and his nut provided short breaks between the main plot for quick comedy. But with the introduction of Scratte, comedy relief transforms into a soap opera. Just like the classic silent films of the golden age of Hollywood, no words are spoken between the two squirrels, but complex emotions still get through to the viewer.
